name: godot-gdextension
description: Native Godot 4 extensions with GDExtension, in C++ (godot-cpp) or Rust (godot-rust gdext). Use when a project has a .gdextension file, SConstruct or a godot-cpp submodule, or when binding a native class, building per-platform libraries, wrapping a C/C++ library, or debugging a native crash.
